rationale: The workflow is a stale-issues/pull-request maintenance workflow (workflow_dispatch, with schedule commented out) containing a single job that already sets timeout-minutes: 10 and a concurrency group. The measured P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT evidence concerns adding a timeout where none existed; this job already has one, and the single CI run (about 26 s) is explicitly labeled not_a_measured_baseline, so a history-derived tighter timeout is unsupported (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT precondition fails, and valid slow runs could exceed a tighter limit). P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE would mean flipping cancel-in-progress to true, but the concurrency group "stale" is not scoped by branch/ref, so distinct branches share the cancellation group, which is a listed contraindication, and canceling a stale-processing run mid-way is not clearly safe. There is no matrix, dependency install, Bazel build, or test step to which caching, fail-fast, or test-selection patterns could apply. Preserving intended coverage, no supported optimization fits.
